INSERT INTO AGP.FAML_BLIV 
WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT 
        BGBG_ID,
        MAX(BLIV_ID) AS BLIV_ID,
        BLBL_DUE_DT AS DUE 
    FROM FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE 
    WHERE BGBG_ID LIKE 'FL%'
    GROUP BY BGBG_ID, BLBL_DUE_DT
)
SELECT 
    C.BGBG_ID,
    C.BLIV_ID,
    C.DUE,
    INID.BLIV_CREATE_DTM,
    INID.GRGR_ID 
FROM CTE C
JOIN FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE INID ON INID.BLIV_ID = C.BLIV_ID
